title: Capstone: Build a House
explanation: This lesson combines everything: loops to repeat work, methods to organize it, and Playground to make it real. Hit Run and watch a house appear around you block by block.
Read through wall(), floor() and roof() below, then try changing the size, the block types, or adding a door gap.
This is the pattern for everything you build from here: think in loops over coordinates, and let a method do the placing.
